description: Backup and verified-restore sidecar: restic to firm-owned Backblaze B2 with Object Lock, monthly restore drills with decrypt canaries, printed Recovery Kit, and bare-metal recovery.

required.name: DOCKER_HOST
required.doc: Filtered Docker socket proxy — never the raw socket. Endpoint allowlist: docs/socket-proxy.md in the Vibe-Backup repo.

required.name: VIBE_BACKUP_PG_CONTAINER
required.doc: The appliance's Postgres container; dumps exec inside it so tooling always matches the server version.

optional.name: VIBE_BACKUP_LOCAL_REPO
optional.doc: Local restic repository path (USB/NAS mount). Empty = B2 only, warned about in the console.

optional.name: VIBE_BACKUP_EXTRA_PATHS
optional.doc: Colon-separated host paths mounted into the sidecar to capture: compose file, caddy_data, env files (build plan §3 items 2/3/4/6).

optional.name: VIBE_BACKUP_APPLIANCE_MANIFEST
optional.doc: Installed-modules list for the appliance-mode discovery cross-check; unset in standalone mode.

optional.name: VIBE_BACKUP_TZ
optional.doc: Firm timezone for the 01:30 nightly backup window. Defaults to container-local time.

optional.name: VIBE_BACKUP_PING_URL
optional.doc: Dead-man's-switch URL, GET after every successful backup (BK-11). Installer sets this to the hosted endpoint per docs/deadman-endpoint.md; any healthchecks-style URL works.

optional.name: VIBE_BACKUP_SMTP_HOST
optional.doc: SMTP relay for failure-alert emails. Unset = email alerts off (console-only).

optional.name: VIBE_BACKUP_SMTP_FROM
optional.doc: From address; defaults to the SMTP user.

_doc: This file is the source of truth for the vendored copy at Vibe-Appliance console/manifests/vibe-backup.json (BK-10a). Appliance integration additionally needs apps/vibe-backup.yml (compose overlay: vibe-backup + its socket proxy, state volume at /var/lib/vibe-backup) and env-templates/per-app/vibe-backup.env.tmpl. No database/redis blocks: the sidecar owns no Postgres database and must keep running when the stack it protects is broken. userFacing false AND no subdomains[] is the appliance's 'no Caddy surface' contract — this UI authenticates nobody, so it is reachable ONLY through the console's authenticated proxy (/admin/apps/vibe-backup/); the 'backup' subdomain field is reserved for standalone mode and never rendered by the appliance.
